en.topic_title: Hong Kong police arrest parents of 11-year-old girl filmed carrying dozens of beer cans
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong police have arrested the parents of an 11-year-old girl who was filmed carrying dozens of beer cans through Tuen Mun while her father stood by and berated her.



Screenshot from video showing the girl made to hold bags of beer, posted on October 6, 2026. Photo: Screenshot via Facebook.



The 38-year-old man and his 32-year-old wife were detained on suspicion of “ill-treatment or neglect by those in charge of a child or young person” – commonly known as child abuse &
